run_adaptive_router_verification: run the end-to-end verification script for the LiteLLM adaptive router with training and convergence phases
test_proxy_health_check: test the proxy health check function to confirm the LiteLLM proxy is reachable at the configured URL
run_send_session: run a multi-turn chat session through the adaptive router and return the model that handled the last turn
test_post_chat_with_retry: test the chat completion POST request with automatic retry and timeout handling for the proxy endpoint
verify_sticky_session_routing: verify that the adaptive router routes all turns of a session to the same model consistently
